k: Goyal: deal 'close to culmination' Trump announces a deal: tariffs to 18% from 50% Joint statement sets out a framework for an interim deal US Supreme Court strikes down the legal basis for the tariffs A new 10% duty on most Indian goods US sanctions law threatens tariffs of up to 100% Still no signed deal Goyal: India will have one of the 'best' deals Commerce Secretary: deal 'more or less finalised' but can't be signed until new US tariff rules are in place Farmers' groups plan protests on 26 November against the US trade deal Report: US may raise tariffs on India and others as soon as this week US proposes a tariff of up to 25% on Indian goods, or 17% with a trade deal India says it has no 'structural excess capacity' and wants tariff concerns settled in the trade talks Delhi Police refuse permission for farmers' march; protests against the trade deal planned nationwide Goyal says the US trade deal is 'close to culmination'

d: India promised Washington it would stop buying Russian oil. Then war closed the Gulf. Now the Gulf is back on top and the US tariff threat is on hold.
k: Tariff threat waived India agrees to halt Russian oil under the US deal Hormuz shuts; analysts expect a return to Russian oil Russian crude imports reach a reported record US law names India at risk of tariffs up to 100% Trump waives the Russian-oil tariffs Gulf overtakes Russia for the first time since the war Russian oil set for a smaller share in November as discounts return India on course for record Russian oil imports in 2026, but refiners expect less next year Russian oil loses its price edge in India as Gulf supplies return, Bloomberg reports

d: An Ebola strain with no approved vaccine has spread across eastern Congo and into four other countries, and fighting is slowing the response.
